{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expense Acceleration", "construction": "Calculate the 3-year change in R&D expenses scaled by total assets, using Compustat data from 2007 to 2009", "rationale": "Firms accelerating R&D investments may be more likely to create innovative products and experience future growth", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Volatility", "construction": "Compute the standard deviation of quarterly inventory turnover over the past 5 years, using Compustat data from 2004 to 2009", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile inventory turnover may be exposed to greater operational risks and earn higher returns to compensate", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Director Compensation Ratio", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of total director compensation to CEO compensation, using Thomson Financial data from 2009", "rationale": "Boards with higher relative compensation may be more effective monitors of management and lead to better firm performance", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration metric", "construction": "Compute the Herfindahl index of customer sales concentrations, using Compustat Segments data from 2007 to 2009", "rationale": "Firms with more concentrated customer bases may face greater revenue risks and earn higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Issuance-Repurchase Ratio", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of net equity issuance to net share repurchases over the past 3 years, using Thomson Financial data from 2007 to 2009", "rationale": "Firms with higher issuance-repurchase ratios may be signaling overvaluation and earn lower future returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": " Pension Funded Status", "construction": "Compute the ratio of pension assets to pension liabilities, using Compustat data from 2009", "rationale": "Firms with better-funded pensions may have lower future liabilities and earn higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "Calculate the number of unique suppliers and customers, using Compustat Segments and Thomson Financial data from 2007 to 2009", "rationale": "Firms with more complex supply chains may face greater operational risks and earn higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "Estimate the present value of environmental liabilities, using Compustat data from 2009 and EPA records", "rationale": "Firms with higher environmental liabilities may face greater future costs and earn higher returns to compensate", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Stock Option Concentration", "construction": "Compute the ratio of employee stock options held by the top 5 executives to total employee stock options, using Thomson Financial data from 2009", "rationale": "Firms with more concentrated employee stock options may have greater agency problems and earn lower future returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Segment Herfindahl", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of geographic segment sales, using Compustat Segments data from 2007 to 2009", "rationale": "Firms with more concentrated geographic sales may face greater country-specific risks and earn higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
